items.title: Rigged Coding Assignment, Abused AI Tool Opened Path to $6 Billion Binance Heist
items.excerpt: Binance’s first incident report traces the record theft to a months-long campaign that compromised three engineers’ computers. The post Rigged Coding Assignment, Abused AI Tool Opened Path to $6 Billion Binance Heist appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Frontline Education Data Breach Impacts Over 1.3 Million
items.excerpt: Hackers exploited a flaw in third-party software and stole the personal information of school district staff and students. The post Frontline Education Data Breach Impacts Over 1.3 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Florida Student Aid Website Hack Puts Data of 4.9 Million People at Risk
